h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Fatehpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Fatehpur

items.pText: Fatehpur lies between Kanpur and Prayagraj, in the doab between the Ganga and the Yamuna. Its schools, colonies and public gardens deal with very hot summers, a short monsoon and cold winters. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment here from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,090 km away, delivered by road and installed by our own team or a local dealer.

One question we hear from first-time buyers is how much space a playground really needs. The answer depends less on the size of each piece than on the safe play area around it. A swing set that looks small on paper needs clear ground in front and behind, and a merry-go-round needs a ring of space on every side. Our layout drawings show this clearly, so you can see what fits before you order.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: The safe play area is the zone around a piece of equipment that must stay free of benches, walls, trees and other equipment. Children move through it when they jump off a swing, land at the foot of a slide or step off a spinning platform. Overlapping these zones is a common layout mistake. Cover the zone with rubber flooring, keep walkways outside it and place seating for parents just beyond its edge.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: How much space does a small playground need?
items.a: It depends on the pieces you choose and their safe play areas. Send us the plot size and we will show on a layout drawing which pieces fit with proper clearance.

items.q: Can benches go inside the safe play area?
items.a: They should not. Benches, trees and walls belong outside it. We mark the boundary on the drawing so seating for parents can go just beyond the edge.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Fatehpur?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground. Send us the plot size and photos to get started.
